description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the ImageAttachmentController in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding plugin. It contains test methods that validate the correct behavior of the controller when handling image requests such as client logos, banners, login images, and invalid inputs.

classes.name: ImageAttachmentControllerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the ImageAttachmentController for various image retrieval scenarios.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes test data by populating the theme configuration from a YAML fixture file before any tests run.

methods.name: testClientLogo
methods.description: Tests retrieving the client logo image, asserting correct headers and content length.

methods.name: testClientBanner
methods.description: Tests retrieving the client banner image, asserting correct headers and content length.

methods.name: testLoginBanner
methods.description: Tests retrieving the login banner image, asserting correct headers and content length.

methods.name: testInvalidImageName
methods.description: Tests the response when an invalid image name is requested, expecting a 400 status code.
